adjudication.rationale: The diff adds essentially the same “fetch credential from DB + hand-map into CredentialWithAppName” block in two places in EventManager.ts: (1) in createAllCalendarEvents(), when a destination.credentialId isn’t found in this.calendarCredentials it calls prisma.credential.findUnique(include app.slug) and then manually builds a credential object; (2) in update workflow (the loop over calendarReference), it repeats the same prisma.credential.findUnique(include app.slug) + manual mapping when reference.credentialId isn’t found. This is a maintainability/duplication issue introduced by the change, not a direct functional defect; extracting a shared getCredentialById helper would reduce divergence risk.
